description:
`discord-to-msg` accepts the messages the WebhookBridge Discord bot forwards from a Discord channel and converts each into UnitySVC's native `msg` format, posted into one of your rooms.

WebhookBridge watches a Discord channel and forwards each new message as JSON (`message`, `display_name`, `message_id`, `attachments`, …). The service maps that event onto the `msg` fields a room takes — the text as `body` (Discord markdown kept as `markdown`), the attachment URLs, and an `origin` of `discord` carrying the Discord message id and the author's display name — and posts it into the room as the member of the connector it came in through, attributed to that connector. The message id doubles as the idempotency key, so a redelivered event is not posted twice. When the room also sends to that Discord channel through msg-to-discord, WebhookBridge forwards those posts back as new events; the gateway answers such an echo (its user_id is the id in your DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL) with 204 before anything is posted. The free gateway channel checks the DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL secret; gateway-plus ($0.001 / message) checks the webhook URL secret the enrollment's webhook_url_secret parameter names, for a room that sends through msg-to-discord's gateway-plus.

In UnitySVC open Rooms → the room → Delivery, add a connector for the Discord channel (or use `main`) and choose Discord to Messages as its inbound service; give WebhookBridge the URL the connector shows as the channel's destination. Several Discord channels into several rooms are several connectors. No enrollment to set up; the DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL you already set for msg-to-discord also stops your own outbound messages coming back. See “How to use this service” for the walkthrough.
name: discord-to-msg
summary: Bring Discord messages into a UnitySVC room: WebhookBridge posts each message here, the gateway converts it into a `msg` and delivers it through your room connector.
tags: warning:unverified?stats.successful_requests==0 | Tested against a simulated upstream only — no customer has used it yet

request_rules.name: own-webhook-echo
request_rules.when: string.find("${ customer_secrets.DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL ?? none }", table.concat({"/webhooks/", body.user_id, "/"}), 1, true) ~= nil

webhook_url_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding the Discord webhook URL this enrollment's room posts to through msg-to-discord; its echoes are dropped

request_rules.name: own-webhook-echo
request_rules.when: string.find("${ customer_secrets.{{ params.webhook_url_secret }} }", table.concat({"/webhooks/", body.user_id, "/"}), 1, true) ~= nil
